lines.text: David stays in Jerusalem while Joab besieges Rabbah, and David sends for Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, and sleeps with her.
David calls Uriah back from the war, but Uriah refuses to go home, even after David sends him a gift.

wrong_details.wrong: even after David sends him a gift
wrong_details.true: even after David gets him drunk

lines.text: David sends Joab a letter with Uriah, and Joab places Uriah where the strongest enemy soldiers are, and Uriah dies.
Joab sends a messenger to David, who says archers shot from the wall and Uriah the Hittite is dead.
David tells Joab to pull back from the city, and after Bathsheba mourns, David makes her his wife.

wrong_details.wrong: David tells Joab to pull back from the city
wrong_details.true: David tells Joab to strengthen his attack against the city and demolish it
